isolation.clipboardInputs: workspace synthetic images and synthetic English prompts only

automaticSaveFromLastTextEvent.note: Values include the configured 600ms stability window plus repository save, gallery refresh and diagnostic emission.

scenarios.name: text copied while image processing
scenarios.evidence: SequentialEventPump test delays image preparation by 100ms and applies the queued text only after image-ready.

scenarios.name: two images copied consecutively
scenarios.evidence: Two unique sessions received prompts newest-first and older-second; exactly two capture-auto-saved events were emitted and the two-item gallery stayed at two items.

scenarios.name: duplicate image
scenarios.evidence: Pixel-hash duplicate updated the existing item with WasDuplicate=true; gallery item count stayed unchanged and the refresh reused existing rows/cards.

scenarios.name: locked source file
scenarios.evidence: Exclusive file lock produced IOException without creating an incomplete capture session.

scenarios.name: corrupt image
scenarios.evidence: Failure persisted with a friendly damaged/unsupported message and appeared in the capsule/inbox. A repeated Windows file-drop event initially created two failures; path-and-time coalescing was added, and sequences 610/612 then produced one failure while sequence 612 was explicitly coalesced.

scenarios.name: exit before save
scenarios.evidence: After process restart the diagnostic reported sessions=1 and pending=1; thumbnail, hash and prompt-wait state were restored.

scenarios.name: exit after save
scenarios.evidence: Saved state, item ID, hash and remaining undo deadline survived repository restart.

scenarios.name: AI worker unavailable
scenarios.evidence: Capture saved and remained searchable with an empty model directory and no AI invocation. AI summary expiration is independent of the undo timer.
